ceil: Metal grid on hangers, two layers of plasterboard, recesses for LED strips and curtain tracks. A bulkhead hides the hood duct and air-conditioning lines.
decor: Textiles, plants, art and small things per the design project. Then a professional post-renovation clean: no dust, film or mortar traces.
demo: We strip old finishes, screed, tiles and the partitions the project removes; old wiring and pipes go completely. Debris goes into bags and is hauled away. Load-bearing walls stay untouched.
demo_n: We check the developer's shell: wall geometry, slab level differences, windows and service entries. Then we clean, dedust and prime the concrete.
design: The plan goes onto the concrete: zoning, furniture, tile layout, socket, lighting and plumbing drawings. From here everything follows the drawings, done by our in-house team.
done: We walk the apartment with you against a checklist, sign the acts and hand over the hidden-services drawings and the keys. Warranty: 12 months.
doors: Flush doors level with the wall for the bathroom, WC and closet; standard doors with frames and casings for the rooms. A steel entrance door with seals.
elec: Chases, back boxes, junction boxes and cables per drawing; dedicated lines for the kitchen, water heater and underfloor heating. A panel with breakers and RCDs; internet, TV and intercom run separately. Air-conditioning lines go in now too.
elec_o: The old wiring comes out completely. New copper cables in chases, back boxes, junction boxes, a panel with breakers and RCDs; low voltage on its own route. Air-conditioning lines go in now too.
floor: Parquet or SPC on a dry, flat screed over underlay, with an expansion gap at the walls. Skirting is flush-mounted or paintable.
furn: Our joiners fit it module by module: base units, worktop, wall units, the appliance tower; then the closet, hallway wardrobe and kids' room.
hydro: Liquid waterproofing over primer: reinforcing tape in corners and collars on pipe outlets, a 20 cm upstand on walls and higher around the bath and shower. The second coat goes on before tiling.
light: We fit the bath, basin, wall-hung WC and mixers and connect the appliances. Lighting scenes: task light in the kitchen, warm evening light, LED in the recesses.
measure: Our specialist scans the apartment with a 3D scanner: the point cloud gives real sizes, heights, slab level differences and angles. The site manager checks it against the plan and service entries.
paint: Plasterboard joints get reinforcing tape. Base and finish filler, sanding under a work light, primer and two coats of paint.
part: Wet areas get 100 mm aerated block on adhesive with reinforced courses; rooms get plasterboard on metal studs with mineral wool for sound insulation. Openings follow the project.
plaster: Primer, guide beads set with a laser level, then plaster: gypsum in rooms, cement in wet areas. Flat walls and square corners for tiles, paint and built-in furniture.
plumb: From the metered entry to a manifold, then PPR or multilayer pipes to every point. Drains fall 2–3 % to the stack; a frame for the wall-hung WC.
plumb_o: Stacks inside the apartment are replaced in agreement with the building management. A manifold, PPR or multilayer pipes, drains falling 2–3 %, a frame for the WC.
screed: Edge strip along the walls, insulation and heating cable where the floor is heated. Guide rails set with a laser level, then a semi-dry screed reinforced with fibre.
tile: Layout per project, from the centre line, no thin cuts. Adhesive with a notched trowel over the second waterproofing coat, even joints on spacers, then grout and sealant in the corners.
win: We check and adjust the developer's windows and add the vapour-barrier tape where it is missing. Then insulated reveals and window sills.
win_o: Old frames come out; new windows go in on anchors with a three-layer warm installation: tapes outside and inside, foam in the joint. Then reveals and sills.
